title: Psychiatrists
description: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent mental disorders.

tasks.text: Prescribe, direct, or administer psychotherapeutic treatments or medications to treat mental, emotional, or behavioral disorders.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing therapy requires licensed clinical accountability

tasks.text: Gather and maintain patient information and records, including social or medical history obtained from patients, relatives, or other professionals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Collect medical information from patients, family members, or other medical professionals.

tasks.text: Collaborate with physicians, psychologists, social workers, psychiatric nurses, or other professionals to discuss treatment plans and progress.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Counsel outpatients or other patients during office visits.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment-effect advice needs clinical tailoring

dwas.name: Advise patients on effects of health conditions or treatments.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Analyze and evaluate patient data or test findings to diagnose nature or extent of mental disorder.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Examine or conduct laboratory or diagnostic tests on patients to provide information on general physical condition or mental disorder.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Patient physical assessment is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.

tasks.text: Design individualized care plans, using a variety of treatments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical plans need exam, liability, and clinical judgment

tasks.text: Advise or inform guardians, relatives, or significant others of patients' conditions or treatment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Results delivery needs empathy and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Explain medical procedures or test results to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Teach, take continuing education classes, attend conferences or seminars, or conduct research and publish findings to increase understanding of mental, emotional, or behavioral states or disorders.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Review and evaluate treatment procedures and outcomes of other psychiatrists or medical professionals.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Quantitative treatment efficacy analysis; researcher verifies

dwas.name: Analyze quantitative data to determine effectiveness of treatments or therapies.

tasks.text: Prepare and submit case reports or summaries to government or mental health agencies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Health records drafted; clinician verifies and signs

dwas.name: Prepare official health documents or records.
Prepare reports summarizing patient diagnostic or care activities.

tasks.text: Serve on committees to promote or maintain community mental health services or delivery systems.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Committee service requires presence, negotiation, accountability

dwas.name: Serve on institutional or departmental committees.

emerging_tasks.task: Perform mental health evaluations to provide information to courts of law on patients' mental states.
Teach and supervise medical students, residents, and nurse practitioners.
